_about: Fictional fact patterns for a blind drafting benchmark. Paste each `brief` VERBATIM into every tool being compared. `key_facts` must appear in a correct draft (a nested list = any one of these spellings). `expect: flag` cases contain a planted legal defect (`trap_issue`) a careful drafter must point out instead of drafting as if it were fine. All names and numbers are invented.

cases.doc_type: Legal notice under Section 138 NI Act
cases.brief: Draft a statutory demand notice under Section 138 of the Negotiable Instruments Act. Sender: M/s. Kaveri Steel Traders, a sole proprietorship of Mr. R. Senthil Kumar, No. 14, Anna Salai, Chennai 600002. Addressee: Mr. P. Arun Prakash, No. 7, Gandhi Road, Tambaram, Chennai 600045. Arun bought TMT bars on credit and issued cheque No. 482913 dated 01.09.2026 for Rs. 3,75,000 drawn on Indian Bank, Tambaram branch, towards the invoice dues. We presented it at our bank, City Union Bank, Anna Salai branch, on 10.10.2026. It was returned unpaid on 13.10.2026 with the memo 'Funds Insufficient'. We received the return memo on 15.10.2026. Notice is from our advocate, Mr. K. Meenakshi Sundaram.

cases.doc_type: Legal notice under Section 138 NI Act
cases.trap_issue: The return memo was received on 05.08.2026, so the 30-day window to send the s.138 notice expired on 04.09.2026. A notice sent now cannot found a s.138 prosecution; the drafter must say so (civil recovery remains).
cases.brief: Draft a Section 138 NI Act demand notice. Sender: Ms. S. Lakshmi, No. 22, Kamarajar Street, Madurai 625001. Addressee: Mr. V. Ganesh, No. 3, North Masi Street, Madurai 625001. Draft an anticipatory bail petition before the Principal Sessions Judge, Coimbatore. Petitioner: Mr. N. Suresh Babu, aged 41, No. 66, Race Course Road, Coimbatore 641018, a textile trader. Draft a default bail petition before the Judicial Magistrate No. I, Tiruchirappalli. Accused: Mr. K. Mohan, aged 35, No. 9, Thillai Nagar, Tiruchirappalli 620018. Crime No. 301 of 2026 of Cantonment Police Station under Section 318(4) BNS (cheating, punishable up to 7 years). Arrested and produced before the Magistrate on 10.08.2026; in judicial custody since then. As of 25.10.2026 no final report has been filed. File the petition today, before any charge sheet is filed.

cases.trap_issue: For an offence punishable up to 7 years the default-bail period is 60 days from first remand (10.08.2026 -> 09.10.2026), but the charge sheet was filed on 20.09.2026, inside that period. No indefeasible right to default bail arose; the drafter must say so rather than claim it.

cases.doc_type: Summary suit under Order XXXVII CPC
cases.trap_issue: There is no written contract, bill of exchange, hundi or promissory note - only an oral loan and a WhatsApp acknowledgement. A summary suit under Order XXXVII does not lie; the drafter should say an ordinary money suit is the remedy.

cases.doc_type: Divorce petition on ground of cruelty

cases.doc_type: Legal notice for refund of security deposit
cases.brief: Draft a legal notice from tenant to landlord for refund of security deposit. Client: Ms. A. Farzana, now at No. 3, Royapettah, Chennai 600014. Addressee: Mr. K. Raman, owner of Flat 2B, Sai Residency, No. 50, Adyar, Chennai 600020. Rental agreement dated 01.06.2023 at Rs. 28,000 per month with a security deposit of Rs. 1,50,000. She vacated on 31.08.2026 after one month's written notice dated 30.07.2026 and handed over keys on that date; the flat was in good condition and all rent and maintenance were paid. He has not refunded the deposit despite WhatsApp requests. Demand refund within 15 days with interest at 12% p.a. from 31.08.2026, failing which legal proceedings will follow. Notice through advocate Mr. S. Ibrahim.
